checkpoint.title: Indigo Plateau's nurse: Victory Road 2F until its nine species are caught

events.why: The Pokedex count before the round.
South down Route 23 into Victory Road 2F by its north door; the cave floor east of the move tutor is all encounter tiles and no trainer sees it.

Victory Road 2F (FireRed, pret src/data/wild_encounters.json): Machop, Geodude and Onix 20% each, Primeape and Zubat 10%, Arbok, Golbat, Marowak and Machoke 5%, Lv 34 to 48. A foe without the caught mark is caught with Ultra Balls; the rest are run from.
Back up Route 23 to Indigo Plateau's nurse: the foes hit Blastoise on every throw.
The Pokedex count after the round.

metadata.notes: A round from Indigo Plateau's nurse back to her, two new species a round, until the count holds the Sevii save's nine Victory Road species (16 caught after 03, 19 after 04, 25 with all nine).
